name: CostReport::from_totals

test_list.description: The total is the exact integer sum of the cost field of every ModelRequestCompleted; telemetry holds no price table.
The per-request average is total / requests with integer division (floor), never a float.
With zero requests the average is zero and from_totals does not divide by zero.
When every request is attributed to a model, the per-model costs add up to the total.
A cost sum above u64::MAX micro-USD pins at u64::MAX and sets the snapshot's saturated flag (documented decision: saturate, not error).
proptest: for random attributed streams total cost equals the sum of ModelUsage.cost over models and the sum of the input costs.

output_description: Total and floor-rounded per-request average in integer micro-USD.
